purpose: The MVP line's first scenario (planning/mvp-m0-plan.md, Scenarios and the harness, Q9): B7's two Linux guests re-hosted on two domain harts under static ownership, with hart 0 as the control hart. It names the binding, the rings, the run limits, the guest programs, and the expected outcomes of the scenario, its negative variants, and its probe images.
trust: Data only. tools/gen-scenario.py checks it against src/mvp-layout.h and tools/gen-dts.py and emits the build header and the checkers' expectation files from it; a change is a rebuild, never a run-time selection.
scope: M0. Hart IDs, domain indices, and VMIDs are identifiers, not authority (S1 H03).
name: two-guests

domains.name: G0
domains.bootargs: earlycon=sbi console=hvc0 panic=-1 oops=panic panic_on_warn=1 -- be.guest=0

domains.name: G1
domains.bootargs: earlycon=sbi console=hvc0 panic=-1 oops=panic panic_on_warn=1 -- be.guest=1

domain_lines: [<s>] Kernel command line: earlycon=sbi console=hvc0 panic=-1 oops=panic panic_on_warn=1 -- be.guest=<g>

rejected: extension is not available in SBI

variants.name: payload
variants.change: the kernel's magic2 RSC\x05 becomes RSC\x00

variants.name: exit-budget
variants.change: each domain's exit ceiling is 64

variants.name: run-timeout
variants.change: the run budget is 2^20 ticks

variants.name: ring-full
variants.change: each outbound ring is 1 KiB, and hart 0 waits 0x2000000 ticks after both domains' ENTERED before its first LINE drain (Plan revision M0-A.3)

variants.name: hart-start
variants.change: block 1 names hart 9

variants.name: init-exit
variants.change: G1's DTB has rdinit=/init-exit

variants.name: rdcycle
variants.change: G0's DTB has rdinit=/init-rdcycle

variants.name: no-sstc
variants.change: the accepted R5 QEMU CPU, without Sstc

variants.name: firmware-version
variants.change: the earlier firmware, OpenSBI v1.6 as pinned by MVP_PIN_OPENSBI_*, reports SBI 2.0

variants.name: sbi-time
variants.change: both DTBs without sstc

variants.name: shim-rule
variants.change: the shim starts hart 1 at its entry and stops the hart that booted

variants.name: two-guests-shell
variants.change: each domain's DTB has rdinit=/init-shell and the sealed configuration grants each console input (planning/mvp-m7-plan.md, Q4); tests/session-typist.py types sessions/shell.json

variants.name: hostile
variants.change: G0's DTB has rdinit=/init-hostile, which prints every byte value, a look-alike of hart 0's run line and of G1's prefix, a terminal query and a window title, and a 300-byte line (planning/mvp-m7-plan.md, D-4); no domain is granted console input

variants.name: two-guests-off
variants.change: the scenario's image built without the physical boundary (planning/mvp-m11-plan.md, D-12; M11-7), for its rows on the rva23 and plic machines, which run under QEMU's own device tree; no-sstc and firmware-version boot it too, and shim-rule's monitor is its

variants.name: ring-full-off
variants.change: ring-full's image built without the physical boundary (planning/mvp-m11-plan.md, D-12; M11-7), run under QEMU's own device tree: each VS-domain hart, unconfined, prints its own failure (Plan revision M0-A.3), the path a confined hart no longer takes

variants.name: boundary-absent
variants.change: the M11 firmware without the boundary extension (its configuration's CONFIG_SBI_ECALL_DCOMMIT off; the lock's MVP_PIN_FIRMWARE_NO_BOUNDARY_BIN_SHA256) under two-guests' own tree (planning/mvp-m11-plan.md, D-10's negative 1; M11-7): the probe finds no extension, and no VS-domain hart starts

variants.name: boundary-no-identity
variants.change: two-guests' tree without config-digest (D-10's negative 1a; M11-7): the firmware has no identity to give, the read's error ends the run, and no VS-domain hart starts

variants.name: boundary-identity
variants.change: two-guests' tree with two-guests-shell's identity as config-digest (D-10's negative 2; M11-7): the firmware gives another image's identity, and no VS-domain hart starts

variants.name: boundary-two-narrow
variants.change: two-guests' tree with both VS-domain harts in both narrow OpenSBI domains (D-10's negative 3; M11-7): each confine is refused and its hart parks in the stub before READY

variants.name: boundary-wrong-boot
variants.change: two-guests' tree with be_g0's boot hart 2 and be_g1's 1 (D-10's negative 3; M11-7): each confine is refused and its hart parks in the stub before READY

variants.name: boundary-no-list
variants.change: two-guests' tree with neither narrow OpenSBI domain holding ecall-allowlist (D-10's negative 3; M11-7): each confine is refused and its hart parks in the stub before READY

variants.name: boundary-no-window
variants.change: two-guests' tree with be_g0's regions lacking its window (D-10's negative 4; M11-7): hart 1 is confined, and its guest's first fetch takes an access fault

variants.name: boundary-control-absent
variants.change: two-guests' step-1 tree, the backend's render without be_control (planning/mvp-m11-plan.md, D-6 step 6, D-10; M11-8): hart 0 is listed in one non-root OpenSBI domain alone, so its own confine is refused after both VS-domain harts are started, and its boot code ends the run

variants.name: boundary-control-no-list
variants.change: two-guests' tree with be_control lacking its ecall-allowlist (D-6 step 6, D-10; M11-8): hart 0's own confine is refused after both VS-domain harts are started, and its boot code ends the run

variants.name: boundary-control-wrong-boot
variants.change: two-guests' tree with be_control's boot hart 1 (D-6 step 6, D-10; M11-8): hart 0's own confine is refused after both VS-domain harts are started, and its boot code ends the run

variants.name: boundary-control-two-narrow
variants.change: two-guests' tree with hart 0 also in be_g0's possible harts (D-6 step 6, D-10; M11-8): hart 0 is listed in three non-root OpenSBI domains, so its own confine is refused after both VS-domain harts are started, and its boot code ends the run

variants.name: boundary-control-no-mailbox
variants.change: two-guests' tree with be_control's regions lacking the VS-domain harts' mailboxes (D-6 step 6, D-10; M11-8): hart 0 is confined, and its first read of a VS-domain hart's mailbox takes an access fault, which its vector ends the run on
